en: Catch all three frogs! They hop around by themselves.
Each frog is an object of the world, made from your `class Frog`.
Change the code: make the frogs faster, or let them run away from you.
sk: Chyť všetky tri žaby! Skáču samy.
Každá žaba je objekt sveta, urobený z tvojej `class Frog`.
Zmeň kód: zrýchli žaby alebo nech pred tebou utekajú.

lesson: # Round 1: make the animal move with the arrow keys.

goal.en: Write `def on_key(key):` and call `go(key)` inside it.
Write `class Frog(Critter):` with an `on_tick(self)` that turns and steps.
goal.sk: Napíš `class Frog(Critter):` s `on_tick(self)`, ktorá sa otočí a skočí.

goal.en: Write `def on_touch(critter):` that removes the frog and adds a point.
goal.sk: Napíš `def on_touch(critter):`, ktorá žabu odstráni a pridá bod.

goal.en: Use `where()` in the frog's `on_tick`: if the fox is near, hop the other way.
goal.sk: Použi `where()` v `on_tick` žaby: keď je líška blízko, skoč na druhú stranu.

goal.en: Pick a twist card and add it to your game. Then press "Test my game".
goal.sk: Vyber si kartu s nápadom a pridaj ho do hry. Potom stlač „Otestuj moju hru“.
